name: keep-query
description: Use when users want to query, view, or check their health data from Keep or Keep App, including exercise records, body measurements, health metrics, daily statistics, or recent trends. Prefer this skill for utterances like "查一下我这个月跑步的公里数", "我最近一次体重是多少", "上周运动总时长", or "最近的静息心率".
author: Keep
